title: IVG Savr 3000 Kiwi Passionfruit Guava Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Kiwi Passionfruit Guava IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pods combine three tropical fruit flavours for a bright and juicy vape. Sweet-tart Kiwi, tangy Passionfruit and soft, fragrant Guava deliver an exotic and satisfying all-day vape. Each refill includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a 4ml refill reservoir. Once assembled and inserted into the device, the refill system automatically feeds the pod as you vape. The mesh coil provides consistent vapour and rich flavour throughout. Made for use exclusively with the IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to set up IVG Savr Prefilled pod Step 1: Unpack the Device Remove the cap from the mouthpiece. Take out the silicone stopper from the pod. Step 2: Prepare the Refill Peel off the red sticker. Remove the rubber stop. Step 3: Connect the Pod Align the refill with the pod. Press until you hear a click. Step 4: Insert into Device Slide the full pod-and-refill unit into the Savr device. Step 5: Prime the Coil Wait a few minutes to let the coil fully saturate. ✅ Ready to Vape! Inhale to activate and enjoy.
